description: A Python script for extracting network activity data from a MISP database, supporting command-line options for filtering and output formatting, including netflow data.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the PyMISP connection with configuration settings.

methods.name: get_event
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specified event from the MISP database and processes its attributes.

methods.name: build_entry
methods.description: Constructs a formatted string for a network attribute entry, optionally including comments.

methods.name: print_events
methods.description: Outputs the collected network attributes based on the specified filters and format.
